findings.title: Plan document has an empty body
findings.why: The plan is `status: active` but its body is the unfilled scaffold comment, so it records no plan. The scaffold itself says to replace the placeholder.

findings.title: Plan document has an empty body
findings.why: The body is only the scaffold comment, with no plan content.

findings.title: Task left with scaffold comment and no request section
findings.why: The scaffold comment is still in the file, and the file gives only an Outcome with no statement of the request, unlike task-001.

findings.title: Doc names the AUTUMN coupon but the code and tests have no such coupon
findings.why: The expiry fix is described for AUTUMN on 30 November, but the repository has no AUTUMN coupon. The added test uses SPRING and 31 March.
